correctness.rationale: A complete all-n proof gives X as Y plus four-ground-set 5-simplices, a contractible common core, then C(n-1,4) independent S2-boundary attachments; relative homology LES identifies the connecting map integrally as Koszul contraction, whose kernel is exterior fourth power of the augmentation lattice. All quantifiers n>=4, orientation signs, and n=4 zero-wedge case are covered. Finite independent face enumeration, complete discrete-Morse acyclicity and full S5/S6 character checks corroborate the theorem; these experiments are not used as its all-n proof.

value.rationale: Natural complete infinite-family classification for canonical symmetric Kneser graphs at the first nontrivial induced-component cutoff, with all integral homotopy groups fixed by a three-sphere wedge and an explicit natural integral S_n-homology module; contrasts structurally with the known ordinary independence two-sphere result. A contractible-core decomposition and a signed connecting homomorphism are reusable tools, not a one-off numerical computation.
